title: Virtual screening, molecular dynamics and binding energy-MM-PBSA studies of natural compounds to identify potential EcR inhibitors against Bemisia tabaci Gennadius.
authors: Mangat, Harmilan Kaur; Rani, Manisha; Pathak, Rajesh Kumar; Yadav, Inderjit Singh; Utreja, Divya; Chhuneja, Pardeep Kumar; Chhuneja, Parveen
one_liner_zh: 该文用虚拟筛选、MD和MM-PBSA寻找烟粉虱蜕皮激素受体(EcR)的小分子抑制剂，对象是蛋白-小分子而非蛋白-DNA互作，方法虽含AI/物理模拟但与本课题TF-DNA结合机制无关。
abstract: Whitefly (Bemisia tabaci Gennadius) is a hemipteran phyto polyphagous sucking insect pest which is an important pest of cotton that causes economic losses to the crop by reducing its yield and quality. Ecdysteroids such as 20-hydroxy ecdysone (20-E), play a significant role in larval moulting, development, and reproduction in pterygota insects. Receptor of 20-E, that is Ecdysone Receptor (BtEcR) of Bemisia tabaci has been targeted to prevent fundamental developmental processes. To identify potent inhibitors of BtEcr, 98,072 natural compounds were retrieved from ZINC database. A structure-based virtual screening of these compounds was performed for evaluating their binding affinity to BtEcR, and top two compounds (ZINC08952607 and ZINC04264850) selected based on lowest binding energy. Molecular dynamics simulation (MDS) study was performed for analyzing the dynamics and stability of BtEcR and top-scoring ligand-BtEcR complexes at 50 ns. Besides, g_mmpbsa tool was also used to calculate and analyse the binding free energy of BtEcR-ligand complexes. Compounds ZINC08952607 and ZINC04264850 had shown a binding free energy of -170.156 kJ mol-1 and -200.349 kJ mol-1 in complex with BtEcR respectively. Thus, these compounds can be utilized as lead for the development of environmentally safe insecticides against the whitefly.
abstract_zh: 烟粉虱（Bemisia tabaci Gennadius）是一种半翅目植物多食性刺吸式害虫，是棉花的重要害虫，通过降低产量和品质对作物造成经济损失。蜕皮激素类化合物如20-羟基蜕皮酮（20-E），在有翅亚纲昆虫的幼虫蜕皮、发育和繁殖中发挥重要作用。20-E的受体，即烟粉虱的蜕皮激素受体（BtEcR），已被作为靶点以阻止其基本发育过程。为鉴定BtEcR的有效抑制剂，从ZINC数据库中检索了98,072种天然化合物。对这些化合物进行了基于结构的虚拟筛选，以评估其与BtEcR的结合亲和力，并根据最低结合能选出了前两种化合物（ZINC08952607和ZINC04264850）。进行了分子动力学模拟（MDS）研究，以分析BtEcR及得分最高的配体-BtEcR复合物在50 ns内的动力学和稳定性。此外，还使用g_mmpbsa工具计算并分析了BtEcR-配体复合物的结合自由能。化合物ZINC08952607和ZINC04264850与BtEcR复合时的结合自由能分别为-170.156 kJ mol-1和-200.349 kJ mol-1。因此，这些化合物可作为开发针对烟粉虱的环境安全杀虫剂的先导物。
